title: Extending Masked-Cipher Reductions to Higher-Order Security
summary: The bounded-query reduction is established for second-order protection; whether it remains valid for higher-order security with additional probes is unresolved.

formal_statement.body: A bounded-query probing-security reduction to linear cryptanalysis of masked ciphers has been established for second-order protection. The unresolved task is to extend this theoretical framework to higher-order security, where an adversary can place more than second-order probes, and determine whether the reduction remains valid under those conditions. Because additional probes can exploit non-zero correlations over a small number of rounds, establishing adequate security for the extension may require a more detailed analysis of the trails in the masked cipher.

scope.domain: This concerns bounded-query probing security and linear cryptanalysis of masked ciphers.

It notes that additional probes may exploit short-round correlations, requiring more detailed trail analysis.
